-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.Defs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.memberBoot_cmp [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id :
    w64) (cmp : Bool) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id
    cmp m ⊢ ⌜E₀.cmp = cmp⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id cmp m

def etcdstart.grpcLeaseUp (s : Loc) (A : v3rpc.KVAns GF) (regs : List (GoString × val ×
    GoInterface)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ql pl lcid lmid,
      ⌜∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.leaseRegs ql → x ∈ regs⌝ ∗
        v3rpc.quotaLeaseServerAt ql
            { ty := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.LeaseServer.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal pl } s ∗
          v3rpc.leaseServerAt pl s A lcid lmid)

def etcdstart.memberBuilt (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (id : w64) (N : Nat) (served : Bool) (ai₀ at₀ c₀ : w64 := W64 0) (x₀ : apply.ApplyKV :=
    bootKV) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γA ci TM E γrn b cfg γk τ,
      ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
            E.authOn = false ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗
        srvWatchBuilt s E ∗
          isServerBuilt s γA ci TM E ρ ρ.rd (srvEr ρ E₀ ai₀ c₀ x₀ id (srvTrKey γn γk) (srvTrStopK γk)) γrn b ai₀ at₀ c₀ x₀
              N ∗
            srvServeBuilt s E cfg 64 ∗
              srvSVRes s E ∗
                srvMonitorsOff s ∗
                  srvLgReader s ∗
                    srvReadyCloser s ∗
                      srvNetMember γn s id τ ∗
                        srvTrTok γn τ ∗
                          (if served = true then True
                            else [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate http.httpProcSlots (), srvServeRes γn τ) ∗
                            srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗ etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E m ∗ srvStop.keep s cfg E γrn γk)

def etcdstart.cfgOk (token name : GoString) (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig) :
    Prop :=
  cfg.Name' = name ∧
    cfg.DataDir' = name ++ go!".etcd" ∧
      cfg.InitialClusterToken' = token ∧ cfg.NewCluster' = true ∧ cfg.TickMs' = W64 100 ∧ cfg.ElectionTicks' = W64 10

theorem etcdstart.grpcUpM_true [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ :
    ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (gs : Loc) (lis : GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R :
    v3rpc.WSrv GF) : etcdstart.grpcUpM true s E ρ γr gs lis addr cid mid R ⊢ etcdstart.grpcUpOn s E
    ρ γr gs lis addr cid mid R

theorem etcdstart.peerURLsDir_httpURL (dir : w64 → List GoString) (id : w64) (host : GoString) (hd :
    netDirOk dir) (hm : go!"http://" ++ host ∈ dir id) : peerURLsDir dir id [etcdstart.httpURL host]

theorem etcdstart.grpcLeaseUp_persistent (s : Loc) (A : v3rpc.KVAns GF) (regs : List (GoString × val
    × GoInterface)) : Persistent (etcdstart.grpcLeaseUp s A regs)

def etcdstart.srvLeaseRd (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (m : lease.Mode) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ on, lease.srvInv on s E m)

theorem etcdstart.commonPremises_persistent : Persistent etcdstart.commonPremises

def etcdstart.memberBoot [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ
    : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8
    → GName → IProp GF) (id : w64) (cmp : Bool := false) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(⌜ρ.rd.raft = { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
          ρ.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧
            ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false ∧
              ρ.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧
                ρ.rd.kv.cok = E₀.γ.cok ∧
                  ρ.ids.pfx = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∧
                    Φs ρ.ids.pfx = srvFloorFact E₀ ∧ E₀.cmp = cmp ∧ ρ.rd.kv.cmp = cmp ∧ lease.runCfg ρ.rd.kv.lm m⌝ ∗
      (nodeBoot γ.cl srvClusterN γ.vs ctxs id ∗ raftState γ.cl id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ.cl id) ∗
        srvRaftLogInv ρ.rd.raft ∗
          idClusterInv ρ.ids.issued ρ.ids.cnt ρ.ids.wn ρ.ids.fs srvFloorFacts ∗
            idKeyFactAt ρ.ids.fs ρ.ids.key E₀.γ.idx ∗
              idNoZero ρ.ids ∗
                srvPropMint ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids ∗
                  srvRdCtxInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids.issued ∗
                    idShare ρ.ids ∗
                      idWaitTok ρ.ids ∗
                        mvcc.idxFresh E₀.γ.idx ∗
                          ghostMapAuth E₀.γ.cok 1 ∅ ∗
                            ghostMapAuth E₀.γrev 1 ∅ ∗
                              srvReadNamesFreshNK ρ.rd ∗
                                kvInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.rd.kv ∗
                                  ghostMapAuth γ.reg 1 ∅ ∗ ∃ γd, ⌜γ.snapLoc id = some γd⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γd 1 ∅)

def etcdstart.grpcUpM (on : Bool) (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (gs
    : Loc) (lis : GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R : v3rpc.WSrv GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ C q p pw pa il im iu ims is svcs regs sregs,
      ⌜C.A = v3rpc.srvKVAnsM on s E ρ γr (W64 0) [] v3rpc.KVDep.none 0 none ∧
            C.E = E ∧
              (∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.kvRegs q → x ∈ regs) ∧
                (∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.authRegs pa → x ∈ regs) ∧
                  v3rpc.watchSReg pw ∈ sregs ∧ R.s = s ∧ R.E = E ∧ R.wsl = C.wsl ∧ R.γ = C.γ⌝ ∗
        v3rpc.grpcCfgOk s C ∗
          grpcSrvNew gs [il, im, iu] [ims, is] svcs regs sregs ∗
            v3rpc.quotaKVServerAt q
                { ty := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.kvServer.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal p } s ∗
              v3rpc.kvServerIs p s C.A cid mid C.n ∗
                v3rpc.authServerIs pa s ∗
                  v3rpc.isWatchServer pw R ∗
                    (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk il (srvLgReader s) Q) ∗
                      (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk im iprop(True) Q) ∗
                        srvInterceptorOk iu iprop(True) v3rpc.learnerReqOk ∗
                          srvStreamInterceptorOk ims iprop(True) ∗
                            srvStreamInterceptorOk is iprop(True) ∗
                              srvLgReader s ∗
                                srvBemuReader s ∗
                                  srvGoRes s ∗
                                    ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.watchReader C.wsl E.s C.γ) ∗
                                      netListenerAt lis addr ∗ etcdstart.grpcLeaseUp s C.A regs)

theorem etcdstart.bootPremise_of [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog :
    List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok :
    BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) (cfgOk' : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig → Prop)
    (Uok' : BootURLs → Prop) (Hc : ∀ (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig),
    etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg → cfgOk' cfg) (Hu : ∀ (U : BootURLs), Uok U → Uok' U) : (□ ∀ cfg
    U γ, ⌜cfgOk' cfg ∧ Uok' U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
    bootstrapContract cfg U γ id ctxs N dir) ⊢ etcdstart.bootPremise N ps bootLog ctxs dir token
    name Uok id

theorem etcdstart.utf8Keys_insert (M : GMap GoString GoSlice) (n : GoString) (sl : GoSlice) (hn :
    utf8Valid n) (hM : ∀ (k : GoString), (M !! k).isSome = true → utf8Valid k) (k : GoString) : (<[n
    := sl]>M !! k).isSome = true → utf8Valid k

theorem etcdstart.bootPremise_persistent (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id
    : w64) : Persistent (etcdstart.bootPremise N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id)

def etcdstart.grpcUpOn (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (gs : Loc) (lis
    : GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R : v3rpc.WSrv GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ C q p pw pa il im iu ims is svcs regs sregs,
      ⌜C.A = v3rpc.srvKVAnsOn s E ρ γr (W64 0) [] v3rpc.KVDep.none 0 none ∧
            C.E = E ∧
              (∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.kvRegs q → x ∈ regs) ∧
                (∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.authRegs pa → x ∈ regs) ∧
                  v3rpc.watchSReg pw ∈ sregs ∧ R.s = s ∧ R.E = E ∧ R.wsl = C.wsl ∧ R.γ = C.γ⌝ ∗
        v3rpc.grpcCfgOk s C ∗
          grpcSrvNew gs [il, im, iu] [ims, is] svcs regs sregs ∗
            v3rpc.quotaKVServerAt q
                { ty := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.kvServer.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal p } s ∗
              v3rpc.kvServerIs p s C.A cid mid C.n ∗
                v3rpc.authServerIs pa s ∗
                  v3rpc.isWatchServer pw R ∗
                    (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk il (srvLgReader s) Q) ∗
                      (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk im iprop(True) Q) ∗
                        srvInterceptorOk iu iprop(True) v3rpc.learnerReqOk ∗
                          srvStreamInterceptorOk ims iprop(True) ∗
                            srvStreamInterceptorOk is iprop(True) ∗
                              srvLgReader s ∗
                                srvBemuReader s ∗
                                  srvGoRes s ∗
                                    ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.watchReader C.wsl E.s C.γ) ∗
                                      netListenerAt lis addr)

def etcdstart.memberUp (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF)
    (id : w64) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ E cfg γw,
      ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
            E.authOn = false ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗
        isServerReq s E { wait := γw, rd := ρ.rd } ∗
          isServerRead s E ρ.rd ∗
            srvGoRes s ∗
              srvLgReader s ∗
                ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), srvReadReader s ρ.rd) ∗
                  srvWatchBuilt s E ∗
                    srvServeFacts s E cfg ∗
                      srvBemuReader s ∗
                        ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvLeadTimeReader s) ∗
                          ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (64 - 2) (), srvLgReader s) ∗
                            ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), E.RD) ∗
                              ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.storeReader E.s E.γ) ∗
                                ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvBemuReader s) ∗
                                  etcdstart.srvPeerCtl γn s id ∗
                                    srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗
                                      etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E m ∗ ∃ dd, srvStopRight s E ρ.rd.raft.raft ρ id dd)

theorem etcdstart.memberBootOn_cmp [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id :
    w64) (cmp : Bool) : etcdstart.memberBootOn γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id cmp ⊢ ⌜E₀.cmp = cmp⌝ ∗
    etcdstart.memberBootOn γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id cmp

def etcdstart.commonPremises : IProp GF :=
  iprop(rnLoggerZapOk ∗ rnSetLoggerOk ∗ rnTimeoutDetectorOk ∗ rnNewStorageOk ∗ v3rpc.runsNoRequireLeader)

def etcdstart.bootPremise (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ cfg U γ,
        ⌜etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg ∧ Uok U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
          bootstrapContract cfg U γ id ctxs N dir)

theorem etcdstart.grpcUpM_false [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ :
    ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (gs : Loc) (lis : GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R :
    v3rpc.WSrv GF) : etcdstart.grpcUpM false s E ρ γr gs lis addr cid mid R ⊢ etcdstart.grpcUp s E ρ
    γr gs lis addr cid mid R

def etcdstart.httpURL (host : GoString) : net.url.URL :=
  { Scheme' := go!"http", Opaque' := [], User' := null, Host' := host, Path' := [], Fragment' := [],
    RawQuery' := [], RawPath' := [], RawFragment' := [], ForceQuery' := false, OmitHost' := false }

def etcdstart.srvPeerCtl (γn : NetNames GF) (s : Loc) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ τ, srvNetMember γn s id τ ∗ srvTrTok γn τ)

theorem etcdstart.srvLeaseRd_lessorRd [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (m :
    lease.Mode) : etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E m ⊢ srvLessorRd s E.γ.leases ∗ lease.lessorRdPool
    E.γ.leases

def etcdstart.env₀ (idx : mvcc.IdxNames) (cok rev : GName) (cmp : Bool := false) : apply.AEnv GF :=
  { s := null,
    γ :=
      { idx := idx, bucket := 0, clog := 0, leases := 0, revs := 0, hook := 0, hookFn := 0, kb := none, cmeta := 0,
        fin := 0, sch := { run := 0, jobs := 0, pay := 0 }, cok := cok, watchQ := false },
    P := iprop(True), f := intoVal (), RD := iprop(True), γrev := rev, authMode := auth.AuthMode.off, FS := iprop(True),
    ciC := fun x x_1 => True, RO := fun x => iprop(True), RW := iprop(True), γbe := 0, cmp := cmp }

def etcdstart.memberUpOn (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF)
    (id : w64) (γa : auth.AuthNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ E cfg γw,
      ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
            E.authMode = auth.AuthMode.on γa ∧
              cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗
        isServerReqM true s E { wait := γw, rd := ρ.rd } ∗
          isServerReadM true s E ρ.rd ∗
            srvAuthLb s E ∗
              srvGoRes s ∗
                srvLgReader s ∗
                  ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), srvReadReader s ρ.rd) ∗
                    srvWatchBuilt s E ∗
                      srvServeFacts s E cfg ∗
                        srvBemuReader s ∗
                          ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvLeadTimeReader s) ∗
                            ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (64 - 2) (), srvLgReader s) ∗
                              ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), E.RD) ∗
                                ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.storeReader E.s E.γ) ∗
                                  ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), srvBemuReader s) ∗
                                    etcdstart.srvPeerCtl γn s id ∗
                                      srvWatchReaders s E 64 ∗ □ (srvTLSId s -∗ False) ∗ srvAuthStoreOn s E.RD)

def etcdstart.grpcUp (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ : ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) (gs : Loc) (lis :
    GoInterface) (addr : GoString) (cid mid : w64) (R : v3rpc.WSrv GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ C q p pw il im iu ims is svcs regs sregs,
      ⌜C.A = v3rpc.srvKVAns s E ρ γr (W64 0) [] v3rpc.KVDep.none ∧
            C.E = E ∧
              (∀ (x : GoString × val × GoInterface), x ∈ v3rpc.kvRegs q → x ∈ regs) ∧
                v3rpc.watchSReg pw ∈ sregs ∧ R.s = s ∧ R.E = E ∧ R.wsl = C.wsl ∧ R.γ = C.γ⌝ ∗
        v3rpc.grpcCfgOk s C ∗
          grpcSrvNew gs [il, im, iu] [ims, is] svcs regs sregs ∗
            v3rpc.quotaKVServerAt q
                { ty := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.kvServer.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal p } s ∗
              v3rpc.kvServerIs p s C.A cid mid C.n ∗
                v3rpc.isWatchServer pw R ∗
                  (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk il (srvLgReader s) Q) ∗
                    (□ ∀ Q, srvInterceptorOk im iprop(True) Q) ∗
                      srvInterceptorOk iu iprop(True) v3rpc.learnerReqOk ∗
                        srvStreamInterceptorOk ims iprop(True) ∗
                          srvStreamInterceptorOk is iprop(True) ∗
                            srvLgReader s ∗
                              srvBemuReader s ∗
                                srvGoRes s ∗
                                  ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate 64 (), mvcc.watchReader C.wsl E.s C.γ) ∗
                                    netListenerAt lis addr ∗ etcdstart.grpcLeaseUp s C.A regs)

def etcdstart.memberBootOn [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (γ : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List
    w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id : w64) (cmp : Bool := false) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ρ.rd.raft = { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
          ρ.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧
            ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = apply.alarmChain true false false ∧
              ρ.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧
                ρ.rd.kv.cok = E₀.γ.cok ∧
                  ρ.ids.pfx = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∧
                    Φs ρ.ids.pfx = srvFloorFact E₀ ∧
                      E₀.cmp = cmp ∧ ρ.rd.kv.cmp = cmp ∧ (∃ m, lease.runCfg ρ.rd.kv.lm m) ∧ ρ.rd.kv.lg = false⌝ ∗
      (nodeBoot γ.cl srvClusterN γ.vs ctxs id ∗ raftState γ.cl id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ.cl id) ∗
        srvRaftLogInv ρ.rd.raft ∗
          idClusterInv ρ.ids.issued ρ.ids.cnt ρ.ids.wn ρ.ids.fs srvFloorFacts ∗
            idKeyFactAt ρ.ids.fs ρ.ids.key E₀.γ.idx ∗
              idNoZero ρ.ids ∗
                srvPropMint ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids ∗
                  srvRdCtxInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids.issued ∗
                    idShare ρ.ids ∗
                      idWaitTok ρ.ids ∗
                        mvcc.idxFresh E₀.γ.idx ∗
                          ghostMapAuth E₀.γ.cok 1 ∅ ∗
                            ghostMapAuth E₀.γrev 1 ∅ ∗
                              srvReadNamesFreshNK ρ.rd ∗
                                kvInvM true ρ.rd.raft ρ.rd.kv srvAuthSt0 ∗
                                  ghostMapAuth γ.reg 1 ∅ ∗ ∃ γd, ⌜γ.snapLoc id = some γd⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γd 1 ∅)

def etcdstart.urls1 (name peerAddr client : GoString) (U : BootURLs) : Prop :=
  U.peer = [etcdstart.httpURL peerAddr] ∧
    U.client = [etcdstart.httpURL client] ∧
      (∃ sl, U.initMap = <[name := sl]>∅) ∧ U.initURLs name = [etcdstart.httpURL peerAddr]

theorem etcdstart.serveViews_off [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (ρ :
    ReqNames) (γr : ReadNames) : isServerReq s E ρ ∗ isServerRead s E γr ⊢ ⌜E.authOn = false ∧
    E.authMode ≠ auth.AuthMode.any⌝ ∗ isServerReqM E.authOn s E ρ ∗ isServerReadM E.authOn s E γr ∗
    srvAuthLb s E

theorem etcdstart.srvLeaseRd_persistent (s : Loc) (E : apply.AEnv GF) (m : lease.Mode) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E m)

def etcdstart.bootCCOk (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : EntryM), e ∈ bootLog → ccIdOf e.Data' = W64 0 ∧ ccBootOk (listToSet ps) e.Data'

theorem etcdstart.discoveryZero_len : (zero_val
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3discovery.DiscoveryConfig).ConfigSpec'.Endpoints'.len
    = W64 0

def etcdstart.urls3 (n₁ n₂ n₃ : GoString) (iu : GoString → List net.url.URL) (peerAddr client :
    GoString) (U : BootURLs) : Prop :=
  U.peer = [etcdstart.httpURL peerAddr] ∧
    U.client = [etcdstart.httpURL client] ∧
      (∃ sl₁ sl₂ sl₃, U.initMap = <[n₃ := sl₃]><[n₂ := sl₂]><[n₁ := sl₁]>∅) ∧ U.initURLs = iu

theorem etcdstart.utf8Keys_empty (k : GoString) : (∅ !! k).isSome = true → utf8Valid k

theorem etcdstart.env₀_cmp [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (idx : mvcc.IdxNames) (cok rev : GName) (cmp : Bool) : (etcdstart.env₀ idx cok rev cmp).cmp =
    cmp

theorem etcdstart.bootCfgOk_of (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig) (hlg :
    cfg.Logger' ≠ null) (hq : cfg.QuotaBackendBytes' = W64 0) (hbl : cfg.BackendBatchLimit' = W64 0)
    (hdf : cfg.BootstrapDefragThresholdMegabytes' = W64 0) (het : cfg.ElectionTicks' = W64 10) :
    bootCfgOk cfg
